anomalies.observed: The ESP32-C3 USB D− net, connected to USB-C connector J2 pins A7/B7, is also connected to the WS2812B status LED D6 DIN input.
anomalies.expected: The USB data line and status-LED data input should be on separate nets so LED signaling does not load or interfere with USB data/programming.

evidence.quote: GPIO18/USB_D− NET0004; J2 A7/B7 D− NET0004; D6 DIN NET0004 (Microcontroller sheet, page 2/4).
Accepts power from either a 12 V barrel jack (J11, run supply) or USB-C 5 V (J12, logic/programming supply) ... and a single onboard WS2812B status LED (D1).

anomalies.impact: USB D− activity can be interpreted as LED data, potentially causing unintended LED updates; the WS2812B input and its wiring may also degrade USB signaling and make USB communication or programming unreliable.

parsed.summary: The schematic connects the WS2812B data input directly to the ESP32-C3 USB D− net, which is also routed to the USB-C connector. This creates a shared signal path that can interfere with both USB communication and LED operation.
